# MarketWatch

> MarketWatch provides real-time stock market news, financial data, and investment guidance for individual investors and traders.

MarketWatch is a leading financial news and analysis platform covering equity markets, commodities, cryptocurrencies, and personal finance topics. The site serves investors with market quotes, news analysis, and retirement planning resources across multiple asset classes and geographies.

## Key Topics

- stock market news
- financial news
- market data
- investment advice
- retirement planning
- tech stocks
- crypto banking
- Dow Jones
- Nvidia
- Boeing
- Honeywell
- IRA
- Eastern Time Zone
